data.label: Innovation
data.description: A tendency to be inventive, to be imaginative, and to adopt new perspectives on ways to accomplish work.
data.note: The report's Table 1 groups it under Openness; its Table 3 lists Compound Dimension. Table 1 is used here.

data.label: Achievement Orientation
data.description: A tendency to establish and maintain personally challenging work-related goals, set high work-related standards, and exert high effort toward meeting those goals and standards.

data.label: Intellectual Curiosity
data.description: A tendency to seek out and acquire new work-related knowledge and obtain a deep understanding of work-related subjects.

data.label: Tolerance for Ambiguity
data.description: A tendency to be comfortable with ambiguity and uncertainty at work.

data.label: Initiative
data.description: A tendency to be proactive and take on extra responsibilities and tasks that may fall outside of one's required work role.

data.label: Adaptability
data.description: A tendency to be open to and comfortable with change, new experiences, or ideas at work.

data.label: Self-Confidence
data.description: A tendency to believe in one's work-related capabilities and ability to control one's work-related outcomes.

data.label: Perseverance
data.description: A tendency to exhibit determination and resolve to perform or complete tasks in the face of difficult circumstances or obstacles at work.

data.label: Leadership Orientation
data.description: A tendency to lead, take charge, offer opinions, and provide direction at work.

data.label: Humility
data.description: A tendency to be modest and humble when interacting with others at work.

data.label: Sincerity
data.description: A tendency to be genuine and sincere in interactions with others at work, without concern for personal gain or self-interest.

data.label: Empathy
data.description: A tendency to show concern for others and be sensitive to others' needs and feelings at work.

data.label: Cooperation
data.description: A tendency to be pleasant, helpful, and willing to assist others at work.

data.label: Optimism
data.description: A tendency to exhibit a positive attitude and positive emotions at work, even under difficult circumstances.

data.label: Social Orientation
data.description: A tendency to seek out, enjoy, and be energized by social interaction at work.

data.label: Cautiousness
data.description: A tendency to be careful, deliberate, and risk-avoidant when making work-related decisions or doing work.

data.label: Attention to Detail
data.description: A tendency to be detail-oriented, organized, and thorough in completing work.

data.label: Dependability
data.description: A tendency to be reliable, responsible, and consistent in meeting work-related obligations.

data.label: Integrity
data.description: A tendency to be honest and ethical at work.

data.label: Stress Tolerance
data.description: A tendency to cope and function effectively in stressful situations at work.

data.label: Self-Control
data.description: A tendency to remain calm and composed and to manage emotions effectively in response to criticism or difficult situations at work.
